findings.summary: run_repair calls rewrite_links_and_indices with old_text_by_path={} unlike run_apply, so placement/index rewrites after crash recovery may be weaker or behave differently than a clean --apply.
If planned vs completed rename sets diverge, run_apply still rewrites refs and overwrites the audit before returning 1, leaving a partially mutated tree with a non-zero exit.

risks.summary: New _compile_path_ref_pattern uses re.compile / re.Pattern but the shown import hunks only add hashlib and datetime. If import re was not already present, plain-ref rewrite raises NameError at runtime; new unit tests would catch this if executed.

--repair trusts journal JSONL (paths and sha256). A malicious or wrong journal can drive _safe_move under repo_root; main resolves args.repair via (repo_root / args.repair).resolve(), which accepts absolute paths outside the repo. Operator-trusted CLI surface, not remote.
Preflight _exists_exact then later moves remain TOCTOU under concurrent deletion; journal + --repair mitigate crash windows but not hostile concurrent writers.

Auditor did not execute tests, import the module, or verify CI against head 7908ae81cda75e6dfeffdd1e53a9f7037ff9cd81; correctness of the new apply/repair paths is inferred from diff and test intent only.

rationale: PR 1464 hardens scripts/check_docs_filename_hygiene.py --apply with fail-closed missing-source preflight, fsync'd JSONL rename journal, sha256-checked --repair, case-exact existence on macOS, whole-token path-ref rewriting (longest-key-first, worktree skip prefixes, strict UTF-8 / byte-preserving writes), and audit retention via keep_previous. Accompanying tests/scripts/test_docs_filename_hygiene_apply.py exercises vanished-source fail-closed behavior, token-boundary rewrites, worktree non-touch, CRLF/BOM/non-UTF-8 preservation, mid-phase crash journal + idempotent repair, and CLI --repair parsing, all under tmp_path. No instruction-like content was reported by the scanner. Residual risks are operational (journal trust, possible missing re import not visible in hunks, repair rewrite asymmetry, validation not executed), not clear remote-exploitation defects in the diff, so PASS_WITH_RISKS rather than PASS or FAIL.
